query:
-- Vérifier les liaisons pour les 13 paires de doublons
SELECT pm.molecule_id, m.name, COUNT(*) as nb_liaisons
FROM plant_molecules pm
JOIN molecules m ON m.id = pm.molecule_id
WHERE pm.molecule_id IN (90021,570071, 120010,570024, 570055,1620004, 690011,990018, 720005,960010, 720013,1710027, 720018,1320002, 840013,1410054, 870001,990037, 960013,1320036, 1320209,1350030, 1710003,1710050, 1710028,1710029)
GROUP BY pm.molecule_id, m.name
ORDER BY pm.molecule_id;
